# Puna Tech — Autonomous B2B AI Agents & Systems Architecture

> Puna Tech builds production-grade autonomous AI agents, intelligent multi-agent orchestration, and custom software systems for B2B enterprises across Latin America and global markets. Headquartered in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

## Canonical Entity Overview
Puna Tech (https://www.puna-tech.com) is a specialized AI & Software Engineering firm. Rather than deploying generic informational chatbots, Puna Tech engineers deterministic, code-level AI workflows integrated directly with ERPs, CRMs, databases, vector stores, and custom APIs.

## Core Specializations & Services
1. **Autonomous AI Agents & Multi-Agent Systems**:
   - Multi-agent orchestration using Gemini 3.5 Flash, LangChain, LlamaIndex, and Python microservices.
   - Vector database integration (pgvector, Pinecone) for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) over enterprise knowledge bases.
   - Human-in-the-loop (HITL) safeguards with approval thresholds for financial and legal transactions.
2. **AI-Driven Process Automation**:
   - Automated logistics invoice processing, cross-matching, and aduana document extraction.
   - Omnichannel conversational AI (WhatsApp Cloud API, Slack, Web, Telegram) with long-term memory.
   - Bank reconciliation agents achieving 99.8% certified data precision.
3. **Custom B2B Web & Mobile Software**:
   - Modern web application architecture built with React, TypeScript, Node.js, Vite, and PostgreSQL.
   - High-throughput API design, real-time observability, and microservice containerization on Google Cloud Run & Docker.

## Key Verified Performance Metrics & ROI Case Studies
- **Logistics Invoice Automation (GlobalLog)**: Reduced processing time per invoice from 4 business days to 12 minutes (80% reduction), cut error rates to 0.1%, achieving 100% ROI in under 3 months.
- **Enterprise Database Queries**: Lowered critical query latency from 4.2 seconds to 180ms through modular React/Node.js re-architecture.
- **Support Ticket Suppression (TechCorp)**: Reduced repetitive customer support tickets by 65% using cognitive Gemini-powered assistants.
